11 open-source MediaTek projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered MediaTek SoCs and phones. 6 of 11 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: mtkclient, FirmWire, mtk_uartboot, mediatek-lte-baseband-re, MobileInsight core.
